description: Linux kernel crypto API call surface. Prefix families cover the per-tfm-type verb namespaces (crypto_alloc_*, crypto_skcipher_*, crypto_shash_*, crypto_ahash_*, crypto_akcipher_*) and the RNG sources (get_random_*, prandom_*). The crypto_aead_* verbs are exact names, NOT a prefix: libsodium owns the algorithm-qualified crypto_aead_<alg>_* namespace and a kernel crypto_aead_ prefix would mis-attribute those calls.
